insights: Long-form videos severely underperform in discovery (7 to 102 views) compared to Shorts (up to 1,994 views), indicating the channel currently relies almost exclusively on the Shorts feed for reach.

Military tech and space exploration are top view drivers (e.g., US Army Combat Robots at 1,994 views, Satellites at 1,531 views, Artemis III at 861 views with 114% retention), whereas abstract health/climate topics flop (Pancreatic Cancer at 46 views, River Basin at 241 views).
The 'Shocking fact first' style consistently delivers strong views (average ~1,270 views across 6 Shorts), making it the most dependable hook strategy.
'What if' scenarios consistently fail to gain traction in the algorithm (averaging only 320 views across 4 videos), despite decent retention percentages.
Viewer drop-off spikes reliably between 4.8s and 8.9s across Shorts (losing 5% to 15% of viewers), showing that the transition immediately following the hook sentence is where pacing stumbles.
Explicit channel call-to-actions around 22–26s cause significant retention drop-offs (e.g., 4% to 6% drops on 'Follow Tomorrowly' lines) and should be trimmed or removed.
Engagement via comments is near-zero across nearly all Shorts (only 10 total comments across 36 videos), confirming that ending questions fail to provoke viewer discussion.
